items.quote:
On their way they set up camp near Kiriath Jearim in Judah. This is why the place west of Kiriath Jearim is called Mahaneh Dan to this day.
13  From there they went on to the hill country of Ephraim
items.contrast: The immediate departure point for the hill country versus the Danites’ earlier starting point at Zorah and Eshtaol.
items.reason: Zorah and Eshtaol are a plausible alternative because the journey began there, but “From there” refers to the most recently stated location, their camp near Kiriath Jearim. The question and key correctly resolve that reference.
